name: Threat actor profile
description: Builds a full actor profile: overview, targeting, TTPs with ATT&CK mapping, attribution, IoCs, risk to the organization and recommendations. Use it to understand an actor relevant to your sector, geography or technology stack.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Threat actor name
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Name or alias of the actor to profile, e.g. APT29.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste reports about the actor. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to stakeholders.

name: Map threat actors to TTPs
description: Produces one ATT&CK-linked TTP table per threat actor in the material, an analysis of emerging and shared techniques, and detection priorities. Use it to focus defenses on observed adversary behavior.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report(s), article text or analyst notes to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to stakeholders.

name: ATT&CK Navigator layer from a report
description: Maps the adversary behavior in a report to ATT&CK Enterprise v19 and returns a single Navigator layer file (format v4.5), each technique carrying a verbatim supporting quote and a confidence score. Use it to overlay a report against your detection-coverage layer.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Paste the report(s), article text or analyst notes to analyse. Leave empty to let the agent collect from your connected integrations.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Layer name
manual_trigger_parameters.description: Name shown on the Navigator layer.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Product or service
manual_trigger_parameters.description: The intelligence product you deliver to stakeholders.
manual_trigger_parameters.default: ATT&CK Navigator layer for vendor report

name: MITRE ATLAS mapping of AI-related threats
description: Maps AI-related threat activity in the material to MITRE ATLAS in a table with mapping basis, evidence and per-row confidence, flagging rows that need review. Use it to track how AI shows up in adversary activity.

manual_trigger_parameters.label: Source material
